hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the digamma function psi(theta)=polygamma(0,theta), set theta=z, and apply one derivative d/dtheta to obtain polygamma(1,z).
required_assumptions: polygamma(0,theta) is differentiable in theta on the relevant domain
hypotheses.rationale: The two terms are consecutive members of the derivative chain of the digamma function.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the order parameter n of the polygamma family at n=0 and n=1 while keeping z fixed.
required_assumptions: polygamma(n,z) is defined for n=0 and n=1
hypotheses.rationale: Both terms are specializations of a single named function family differing only by the integer order parameter.
